doc: Per-function vector hints for tools/decomp/difftest_v105.py. Keys: SH-2 cart addresses. Fields: why (required text), pointer_returns (callee entries whose stub result is an object pointer), sr_s (pin SR.S on both reference runs), max_steps (reference step cap), retry_pointers (enable --retry-pointers for this function), args {index: {range:[lo,hi]} | {fields:[{offset,size,range|value|pointer}], size}}. Hint values come from a separate per-vector rng; see notes/difftest_v105.md.

0221b5a0.why: scene_value_select (0602e878) returns a descriptor pointer that is stored to entity +30 and reloaded before mov.l @(4,r3); v1.04 provenance does not follow the store/reload (notes/codex_hardfails_20261107.md)

0221cad4.why: same descriptor-pointer return from scene_value_select (0602e878) via entity +30 (notes/codex_hardfails_20261107.md)

0221dc04.why: sibling FSM of 0221b5a0/0221cad4: same scene_value_select (0602e878) descriptor pointer via entity +30; found by --retry-pointers diagnostics

02213ca4.why: clrmac + mac.l: result depends on SR.S; no program code sets S (all ldc ..,SR sites mask with 0xff0f, no reachable sets), so the game runs with S=0 (64-bit MAC), as the C models

02223862.why: printf %d/%u backend: ctx +4 pad mode, +8 field width, +0xC cursor, +0x10 count; random width (~1e9) makes the pad loop unbounded

02223968.why: printf %x backend, same output context as 02223862
